findings.claim: EnumTemplate.cs uses the inverted guard `#if NETSTANDARD2_0 || NETFRAMEWORK`, while every other template uses `#if !NETSTANDARD2_0 && !NETFRAMEWORK`. As a result, generated enum formatters do NOT get [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage] on net6/net8 and other modern TFMs, or in any compilation without those symbols. They get it only on netstandard2.0/.NET Framework, which is the opposite of every other generated type. This misses the 'all generated code' acceptance criterion for enum formatters.

The guard is wider than the compile-safety concern requires, so netstandard2.0/net472 libraries get undecorated formatters and resolvers, contrary to 'all generated code is decorated'.
